### On ratings
Scores indicate “do I think should you read this” and not “is this quality”. There is plenty of good art I don't personally like, and you probably have some gauge of the latter already, so all I can offer is the former.

I try to average ratings at ⭐️⭐️⭐️, following [Tabelog's](https://tabelog.com/en/) rating system to avoid compression. 
- ⭐️: I don't recommend. 
- ⭐️⭐️: You won't miss much by skipping. 
- ⭐️⭐️⭐️ and above: Recommend.

Books I've read, most recently finished first; books without a finish date follow. [See my shelf on Goodreads](https://www.goodreads.com/review/list/119697841?shelf=read&sort=date_read&order=d).
